artworks.title: A Genius Serves a Small Breakfast (Ein Genius serviert ein kleines Frühstück)
artworks.description: The image depicts thin, curving lines intertwining to create an abstract composition on a blank background. The lines form a figure with elongated limbs and feathered wings, along with a spiral shape near the head and a circular object in one hand. Other lines create an arching frame around the central figure.

artworks.title: Perseus (Der Witz hat über das Leid gesiegt) [Perseus-The Triumph of Brain over Body]
artworks.description: The image is a artistic rendering of a bust of a person with exaggerated features. The person is depicted from the shoulders up, with the head turned slightly to one side. The face has prominent, large eyes, a bulbous nose, and a slightly curled mouth. The person has a close-cropped hairstyle, a thick beard covering the entire chin and lower face, and is wearing a simple garment at the collar. No notable jewelry or objects are present. Next to the person's head is a secondary depiction of another human head with equally exaggerated features, seen in profile view, with a drooping mouth and elongated chin or tail. The background is a textured, monochromatic surface.

artworks.title: Small World (Kleinwelt)
artworks.description: The image shows intricate patterns of lines and shapes on a canvas. The abstract composition includes forms resembling faces, crosses, and celestial bodies. The densely packed elements create a mix of organic and geometric forms, suggesting a cityscape or a night sky. The detailed textures and line work reveal shapes reminiscent of mechanical parts or totemic symbols, adding layers to the artwork's abstraction.

artworks.title: Garden of Passion (Garten der Leidenschaft)
artworks.medium: etching in black on ivory wove paper
artworks.description: The image features crisscrossing lines and shapes forming a dense pattern. The abstract design resembles a scene reminiscent of a jungle or lush garden, with leaf-like structures and bounding figures resembling plants and small animals. The intersecting lines and shadings create an intricate maze of shapes resembling stylized foliage and small creatures in a natural setting.

artworks.title: Blick auf einen Fluss (View on a River)
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketched landscape with an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is high in the composition, separating land from sky. Bold black lines on a beige background illustrate the terrain. There is a path or road in the foreground leading towards the center. Faint outlines in the distance suggest additional hills or formations. The color palette is minimal, using black lines on a beige background.

artworks.title: Shield with Mascaron
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two cherubs holding a large coat of arms. The image depicts two cherubic figures, one on each side, supporting an elaborately decorated heraldic shield. The shield itself features ornate scrollwork and contains an image of a face with prominent eyes and a mustache at its center. The two cherubs have detailed wings and are depicted with flowing garments, standing on a textured ground. This scene is rendered with intricate cross-hatching and line work to emphasize details and shadows. The style of engraving suggests it could originate from the Renaissance period, evident from the date marked "1527" at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene featuring figures in a classical architectural setting. The central figure, appeared to be a female, is seated and holding a child. Other figures surround them, one presenting an open box. Different headwear styles are visible on the figures, along with detailed garments. The drawing includes architectural elements like arches and columns, with intricate line work and cross-hatching for texture.

artworks.title: Saint John
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure observing an apparition of the Virgin Mary and child in a landscape. The scene includes a figure seated on a rocky outcrop, surrounded by trees, gazing upwards toward a vision of the Virgin Mary holding the Christ child. In the background, there is a city with towers and buildings. The figure is holding a book and appears contemplative. The trees are detailed with twisting branches and roots around the figure.

artworks.title: Bettelnde (Begging)
artworks.description: The image shows three figures drawn in a rough and sketchy style. Two adults and a child are depicted, wearing dark clothing. The figure on the left leans forward, their head mostly covered by light-colored hair. The figure on the right has closely cropped dark hair and strong facial lines. Between them, a child stands with a visible face, soft features, short hair, and eyes looking forward. The shading gives depth to the image, and the background features rough, dark textures that blend with the figures.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait at the Table (Selbstbildnis am Tisch)
artworks.description: This image shows a seated person at a table with the upper half of their body visible. The person is positioned at the table with their head slightly turned to the left. Their hair is short and close-cropped, and their facial expression is neutral. The person is wearing a striped shirt or garment with a high collar and long sleeves. Their hands are placed on the table, with one hand holding a utensil and the other resting next to a plate with some food visible. To the person's right, there is a tall, cylindrical lamp casting a glow over the scene, sitting on a small table. The background is dark and textured.

artworks.title: Treason of Judas
artworks.description: This is a painting of an indoor gathering of four individuals in colorful garments. The image features four medieval figures adorned in traditional, ornate garments, engaging in a discussion or storytelling session. The setting is indoors, with visible elements of a stone wall, an arched doorway, and two green, latticed windows in the background. The figures are dressed in a range of colors—blue, green, red, and yellow—and one wears a distinct red and white hat. Their gestures suggest conversation, while their facial expressions show engagement. The painting style is illustrative, with bold outlines and vibrant flat colors, reminiscent of medieval manuscript illustrations or woodcut prints.

artworks.title: Bread (Brot)
artworks.description: The image features a woman holding a child in her left arm while another child stands beside her. The woman is shown from behind, bent over slightly. She has dark hair pinned up, wearing a long-sleeved dress. Both children have similar facial features with wide eyes and simple expressions. They both have curly, short dark hair. The sketch is monochrome with no jewelry or additional objects. The background is plain and light, with the word "Boo!" written in cursive at the bottom.

artworks.title: Germany's Children are Hungry! (Deutschlands Kinder Hungern!)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of four children shown from the shoulders up. Three children are close together in the lower half of the image, while the fourth child is slightly elevated towards the top. The children have varied facial features with wide eyes and open mouths. The sketchy lines depict their hair with a sense of movement. The children wear simple, patterned shirts with visible folds and creases. They hold bowls or containers with bold outlines in their hands. The background is minimal with light shading indicating depth.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait with Hand on Forehead (Selbstbildnis mit der Hand an der Stirn)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black-brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: This print shows a sketch of a person's face, with a detailed depiction of their features. The individual is facing forward with their forehead resting on one hand. The sketch emphasizes deep-set eyes, a broad nose, tightly closed lips, and rough, loosely drawn hair. There are no visible clothes or accessories. The background is plain, off-white paper with some stray dark lines.

artworks.title: The End (Ende)
artworks.medium: aquatint, etching, and emery stone pencil

artworks.title: The Holy Trinity
artworks.description: The image shows a central figure seated and holding a figure draped in cloth, surrounded by angels and celestial beings. There is a dove near the top center. The figures are detailed with flowing robes and expressive faces, creating a solemn and sacred atmosphere. The use of shading and lines adds depth and texture to the drawing, giving it a reverent tone.

artworks.title: The Agony in the Garden
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene. A person in a brown robe is kneeling and looking upwards toward a golden chalice above a rock. Surrounding the kneeling figure, there are three other figures sitting in a semi-circle, each with yellow halos. The style is reminiscent of a medieval woodcut, with vivid colors, a green ground, and a tree in the background. The landscape is simple and stylized, with a blue sky and wooden fence in the distance. The figures and objects are stylized in a way typical of religious art from this period.

artworks.title: Rade de Bordeaux
artworks.description: The image portrays a scene of a bustling port from an elevated perspective. The horizon is high in the frame with ships docked in the harbor, buildings, people on a quay, and maritime activities in the foreground. Ships with tall masts and sails are clustered to the right, showing a sense of activity. The etching technique displays fine lines and intricate details, while the color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and white.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Vineyard
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a castle on a hill in the center, surrounded by countryside. Hills are visible in the distance under the sky. Fine line work, cross-hatching, and stippling create texture and depth in the monochrome image. Figures are seen on the left engaged in agricultural activities. Buildings and roads lead towards the castle at the base of the hill. Trees and architecture are detailed in the distance, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: View of a Town near a River with a Church on the Right
artworks.description: The image displays a village landscape from a high viewpoint. Hills with buildings, including towers, are visible on the horizon. The village is nestled among the hills, with rooftops and stone structures spread out. The detailed line work shows trees on the right and a church with a steeple near rustic buildings. The monochromatic palette focuses on line and texture, highlighting detailed composition.

artworks.title: Georg Roggenbach
artworks.description: The image presents a man sitting upright. His body is angled slightly to the left, but his gaze is direct. The man has distinctive facial hair, a mustache curling upward, and a long beard. He wears a cap and a textured robe with puffed sleeves. He holds a rolled paper. In the background, there is detailed scenery with a castle on a hill, surrounded by buildings and foliage. An elaborate emblem on the wall displays a shield and figures. The sky above the castle is cloudy.

artworks.title: Landscape with Three Men
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river flowing through a valley, surrounded by mountains. There are structures on the horizon. The drawing is detailed, using hatching and cross-hatching for texture. A tree is on the right, and buildings can be seen near the river. The color scheme is primarily grayscale.
